title: Stasium PC level curve
description: Sidecar stasium.level_curve version 1. xp_to_next[i] is the XP to go from level i+1 to i+2. The array has one entry for each level below max_level. The cap is the max_level field, not a frozen number. status proposed. Stat points per level are a later package and are not in this file.
